data.name: 2D elastodynamic metamaterials
data.abstract: This dataset list the location and width of the first band gap for 10x10 pixel 2D elastic metamaterials.

intro_paper.title: How to See Hidden Patterns in Metamaterials with Interpretable Machine Learning
intro_paper.authors: Zhi Chen, Alexander Ogren, Chiara Daraio, L. Catherine Brinson, Cynthia Rudin

variables.name: BandGapLocation
variables.description: Location of central band gap frequency

additional_info.purpose: This dataset was created to predict band-gap data from 2D 10x10 pixels elastic metamaterial geometry
additional_info.funded_by: We gratefully acknowledge funding from the Department of Energy, grant DE-SC0021358
additional_info.instances_represent: The instances are elastic metamaterial unit cell designs that exhibit band gaps.
